AMENDMENT NO. 1 JULY 2022 
TO 
IS 1969 (Part 1) : 2018 TEXTILES — TENSILE PROPERTIES OF FABRICS 


PART 1 DETERMINATION OF MAXIMUM FORCE AND ELONGATION AT 
MAXIMUM FORCE USING THE STRIP METHOD 


( Fourth Revision ) 


(Foreword, para 6) — Insert the following new para after para 6: 


‘This standard also permits the use of constant rate of traverse (CRT) machine for testing of jute fabrics including their 
laminates. Details of which are given in National Annex A.’ 


(Page 11, Annex B) — Insert the following National Annex A after Annex B: 


‘NATIONAL ANNEX A 
(Foreword) 


For testing of jute fabrics including their laminates, the use of constant rate of traverse (CRT) machine is permitted. The 
rate of traverse shall be (450 + 15) mm/min and gauge length shall be 200 mm.’ 


(TXD 01) 


Publication Unit, BIS, New Delhi, India
